title: Latent space configuration for neural network finetuning, fast ranking, and embedding dimensionality reduction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finding K most similar elements for a query in a large gallery of neural network (NN) embeddings is essential in various areas of computer science and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. This paper proposes search algorithms for structured latent spaces (LS) of NNs which allow to speed up top K item retrieval owing to O(1) complexity small candidate gallery subset search. ArcFace-pretrained IResNet50 models are finetuned using Latent Space Configuration (LSC) methodology to obtain new distribution of embeddings with desired geometric properties. Applying the proposed algorithms to embeddings obtained from finetuned models leads to several times speed-up over baseline exhaustive search. Specifically, we report up to 3 times speed-up on GPU and 40% speed-up on CPU compared to the baseline method GPU speed. translated_title: 用于神经网络微调、快速排序和嵌入维度降低的潜在空间配置
translated_abstract: 在大规模神经网络嵌入库中为查询找到K个最相似的元素，在计算机科学的各个领域以及人工智能的工业应用中至关重要。本文提出了针对神经网络结构化潜在空间（LS）的搜索算法，借助O(1)复杂度的小候选子集搜索，能够加速Top K项目的检索。我们使用潜在空间配置（LSC）方法对ArcFace预训练的IResNet50模型进行微调，以获得具有期望几何属性的新嵌入分布。将所提出的算法应用于微调模型得到的嵌入，相比基线穷举搜索可实现数倍的加速。具体而言，与基线方法的GPU速度相比，我们报告了GPU上高达3倍的加速以及CPU上40%的加速。这些结果是在原始和缩减的潜在空间维度下获得的。
tldr: 该论文提出潜在空间配置（LSC）微调方法，使神经网络嵌入具有结构化几何属性，从而支持O(1)复杂度的候选子集搜索，相比穷举搜索在GPU上提速高达3倍、CPU上提速40%，同时还能降低嵌入维度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Latent Space Configuration (LSC), a finetuning methodology that endows neural network embeddings with structured geometric properties, enabling O(1)-complexity candidate subset search that achieves up to 3x speed-up on GPU and 40% on CPU over exhaustive search, while also supporting embedding dimensionality reduction.
